_note: PROTOTYPE stand-in for the pipeline outputs data/atoms/*.json and data/abundance/carbon.json. Values typed from the cited sources for review; the real pipeline must fetch and re-check them.

ionization_eV._source: NIST Atomic Spectra Database, Ground levels and ionization energies (Kramida, Ralchenko, Reader & NIST ASD Team). Successive ionization energies, eV.

electron_affinity_eV._source: T. Andersen, H. K. Haugen & H. Hotop, J. Phys. Chem. Ref. Data 28, 1511 (1999). null = anion not bound.

crust_C._source: CRC Handbook of Chemistry and Physics, 'Abundance of Elements in the Earth's Crust and in the Sea' (C: 2.00×10² mg/kg). PROTOTYPE: licence to be checked; spec fallback applies if not usable.

body_C._source: ICRP Publication 23, Reference Man (1975): carbon 16 kg of a 70 kg body. PROTOTYPE: licence to be checked; spec fallback applies if not usable.
